h1: The 7 Best Power Strips for Desks of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Power Strips for Desks: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven surge-protected power strips for desks in 2026, compared on joules, outlet spacing, USB ports and cord length.
summary: The Amazon Basics 12-outlet strip, rated at 4000 joules, is our top pick for surge headroom on a crowded desk. The ALESTOR 12-outlet strip adds 4 USB ports at 2700 joules. The Nuetsa flat-plug strip is the pick for desks pushed against the wall.
intro: A desk power strip has two jobs, and most buyers only check one. Outlet count gets the attention, but the joule rating decides how much of a surge the strip can absorb before it stops protecting anything.
Every strip here sits in the under $25 bucket. We reviewed the specs and ranked on joules, outlet layout, USB ports and cord length, leaving out review counts.

products.name: Amazon Basics 12-Outlet Surge Protector Power Strip, 4000 Joules, 8ft Extension Cord, Rectangle, for Home, Office, Gaming Room, Black
products.verdict: The highest joule rating here, with 12 outlets and an 8 ft cord.
products.description:
This strip lists 12 outlets, a 4000 joule rating and an 8 ft cord in a rectangle form factor. It is in the under $25 bucket.

It wins because 4000 joules is the most surge headroom in the guide, nearly double the 2100 joule Anker and well above the 2700 joule picks. The tradeoff is no listed USB ports.

It suits a gaming or work desk with many plugs. Pair it with a separate USB charger if you charge phones.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want the most surge-protection headroom for a demanding full desk setup.

products.name: Power Strip, ALESTOR Surge Protector with 12 Outlets and 4 USB Ports, 6 Feet Extension Cord, 2700 Joules, ETL Listed, Black
products.verdict: 12 outlets and 4 USB ports at 2700 joules, ETL listed.
products.description:
The ALESTOR lists 12 outlets, 4 USB ports, 2700 joules, ETL listing and a 6 ft cord.

It takes second place since its 2700 joules trail the 4000 joule Amazon Basics, but the 4 USB ports mean you may not need a separate charger. It matches the top pick on outlet count.

It suits a full desk with phones and tablets. The cord is 2 ft shorter than the Amazon Basics.
cons: Lower joules than the top pick
products.idealFor: Buyers who want maximum outlets with genuine surge protection for a full desk setup.

products.name: Surge Protector Power Strip - Nuetsa Flat Plug Extension Cord with 8 Outlets and 4 USB Ports, 6 Feet Power Cord, 2700 Joules, ETL Listed, Black
products.verdict: A flat plug lets a desk sit close to the wall.
products.description:
The Nuetsa has 8 outlets, 4 USB ports, a flat plug, a 6 ft cord, 2700 joules and an ETL listing.

It ranks third because it has four fewer outlets than the ALESTOR for the same joules, but its flat plug clears furniture pressed against a wall.

Choose it when the outlet is tucked behind a desk. If you need more plugs, step up to a 12-outlet strip.
products.idealFor: Buyers whose desk sits close to a wall outlet needing flat-plug clearance.

products.name: Anker Power Strip with 2100J Surge Protector, Outlet Extender, 20W, 12 AC
products.verdict: 12 AC outlets at 2100 joules with a 20W output.
products.description:
The Anker strip lists 12 AC outlets, 2100 joules and a 20W output.

It ranks fourth because its 2100 joules sit under the 2700 and 4000 joule picks. Buyers pay for the Anker name and the 20W output rather than top surge capacity.

It suits a desk where brand matters. Check the cord length on the listing, as our data does not state it.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want an established-brand surge-protected strip for a full desk.
products.skipIf: Surge capacity is your top priority.

products.name: 6Ft Power Strip Surge Protector - Yintar Extension Cord with 6 AC Outlets and 3 USB Ports for Home, Office, Dorm Essentials, 1680 Joules, ETL Listed, (Black)
products.verdict: A compact 6-outlet strip with 3 USB ports at 1680 joules.
products.description:
The Yintar has 6 AC outlets, 3 USB ports, 1680 joules, an ETL listing and a 6 ft cord, in a compact design.

It ranks fifth because it offers half the outlets of the 12-outlet picks and lower joules. It suits smaller setups where compactness counts.

It works for a dorm or standard desk. Heavier setups will want more headroom.
products.idealFor: Buyers with a standard desk setup who want a balance of outlets and USB ports.

products.name: Amazon Basics Surge Protector Power Strip, 6-Outlet, 790 Joules, Circuit Breaker, LED Indicator, 6ft Extension Cord, White
products.verdict: A basic 6-outlet strip with a circuit breaker and LED protection indicator.
products.description:
This strip has 6 outlets, a 790 joule rating, a circuit breaker, an LED protection indicator and a 6 ft cord.

It ranks sixth because 790 joules is the lowest rating here, but the LED indicator shows whether protection is still active, which several others do not list.

It suits a light setup, such as a laptop and a lamp. Heavy users should step up.
products.idealFor: Budget-conscious buyers with a standard desk setup and modest outlet needs.

products.name: 6 Ft Surge Protector Power Strip - 8 Widely Outlets with 4 USB Ports, 3 Side Outlet Extender with 6 Feet Extension Cord, Flat Plug, Wall Mount, Desk USB Charging Station, ETL, White
products.verdict: Widely spaced outlets with a flat plug and wall mount.
products.description:
This strip lists 8 widely spaced outlets, 4 USB ports, a 6 ft cord, a flat plug, wall mounting and an ETL listing.

It ranks last because no joule rating shows in our data, unlike the others, though the wide spacing fits bulky adapters better than most.

It suits a desk with large power bricks. Confirm the joule rating on the listing.
products.idealFor: Budget-conscious buyers who want widely spaced outlets to fit bulky adapters.
products.skipIf: You need a stated surge rating.

whatMatters.detail: Joules measure how much surge energy a strip can absorb. Higher is better, and a very low rating gives little margin. Look for the number in the product title.
Bulky power bricks block neighboring outlets on tightly spaced strips. Widely spaced outlets avoid this. Check photos and the spacing description.
Built-in USB ports let you charge phones without a separate adapter. They save outlets. Check the USB count in the title.
A 6 to 8 ft cord decides how far the strip sits from the wall outlet. Too short and you need an extension. Check the feet in the title.
An ETL listing means the product was certified against safety standards. A protection LED shows when surge protection has worn out. Look for both in the specs.

faq.q: What do joules mean on a power strip?
faq.a: They show how much surge energy the strip can absorb. The picks here range from 790 to 4000 joules.
Choosing by outlet count alone. A 12-outlet strip with a low joule rating protects less than a smaller strip with a high one.

faq.q: Is the ALESTOR worth it over the Amazon Basics 12-outlet?
faq.a: Only if you want 4 USB ports. The Amazon Basics offers 4000 joules against 2700 and an 8 ft cord.

faq.q: How do I fit big power bricks?
faq.a: Choose widely spaced outlets, like the wall-mount 8-outlet strip, or use a flat plug.

faq.q: How do I know if protection still works?
faq.a: Some strips have an indicator light. The Amazon Basics 6-outlet has an LED protection indicator.
The wide-spacing 8-outlet strip is listed as wall mountable.

finalTake: For most desks, the Amazon Basics 12-outlet at 4000 joules is the safest buy. Choose the ALESTOR if you want USB ports, or the Nuetsa if your desk is flush with the wall. Everything here sits in the under $25 bucket.
